_comment: Hand-verified expected output for fixtures/msm-gig-guide-sample.txt. This is NOT a full 226-row snapshot of whatever the implementation happens to produce -- it's a curated set of representative and edge-case rows, each checked by hand against the raw fixture text, so a future regression in the parser or profile trips a real assertion instead of being silently re-baselined. Row indices are stable because msm-gig-guide-sample.txt's 'View Details' markers are processed in file order. Updated 2026-08 (profile v1.1.0) when the live site changed to a 5-line record structure (title/date/venue/address/View Details, no '* ' bullet on titles, venue and address on separate lines instead of squashed together) -- see sourceProfiles.js's msm-gig-guide section comment for the full diagnosis. The event list itself, its order and every landmark row index are unchanged from the original Sprint 5A sample; only the source markup (and therefore raw/venueBlock) changed.
